item.title: Judge strikes down old Arizona abortion restrictions that clash with voter-backed guarantees
item.description: Arizona's Democratic attorney general supported the plaintiffs.

item.title: The four-year plan: Ninth-ranked Troy United climbs to reach league crown
item.description: The Troy United hockey program has grown immensely since its seniors stepped foot into high school.

item.title: Feds can’t withhold social service funds from 5 Democratic states amid fraud claims, judge rules
item.description: The affected states include California, Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota and New York.

item.title: Justice Department will allow lawmakers to see unredacted versions of released Epstein files
item.description: To access the files, lawmakers will need to give the Justice Department 24 hours’ notice.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to bring back 3 families deported to Honduras, other countries
item.description: The judge said the government relied on “lies, deception and coercion” to deport them.

item.title: High school basketball scoreboard for Friday, Feb. 6, 2026
item.description: Below is a list of all the games for teams, organized by league, covered by outlets in the MediaNews Group Michigan cluster — the Mt. Pleasant Morning Sun, the Macomb Daily, the Oakland Press, and the Southgate News Herald — for Friday, Feb. 6, 2026.

item.title: 2-way player Daniss Jenkins scores 18 points as Pistons rout Knicks, 118-80
item.description: Daniss Jenkins scored 18 points in his last game as a two-way player and the Detroit Pistons routed New York 118-80 on Friday night to end the Knicks’ winning streak at eight games.

item.title: Pistons expect to resolve Jenkins’ status over the weekend
item.description: The Detroit Pistons made it through the NBA trade deadline, but had one important piece of business left before they move forward to the back half of the season.

item.title: No. 1 Michigan rallies for OT victory vs. No. 2 MSU in instant classic
item.description: The first meeting between Michigan and Michigan State’s hockey teams ranked No. 1 and No. 2 turned out to be an all-time classic.

item.title: Photos of Rochester Adams vs. Troy Athens in an OAA Blue girls hoops contest
item.description: Troy Athens battled through a scoring drought early in the second half before pulling away from Rochester Athens for a 43-33 home victory Friday night.
